name: webfluent-browser-tests
description: What only a real browser can check: `offline`'s service worker, `peer`'s WebRTC, the project's own scripts, layers in the top layer, keys, gestures, a project's own storage, long lists, workers, a block drawn into somebody else's node, `wf test` with a project's own stylesheets, a frame drawing the HTML it is given, a store's resources, what a long session lets go of, where a page may send its reader, what a page writes from a value, the built-ins held to the UI standards, every overlay, presses that hold up, the content built-ins, the choosing ones, the collections, and more form controls. `npm test` runs all twenty-three.
